provenance.clean_room_note: Behavioral type grammar only. No vendor bytes, coefficient rows, endpoint tables, or protected preset data are copied.

runtime_contract.secondary_policy: Secondary/Q may change radius, notch depth, and gain pressure. It may not move pole or zero center frequency for the same Morph endpoint.

primitives.name: local_peak_notch
primitives.mountain_canyon_use: Use when the lane should read as a sharp ridge or swallowed ridge, with the zero close enough to create a visible notch collision.

primitives.name: high_zero_cliff
primitives.mountain_canyon_use: Use when the high band must collapse, cap, or tilt while the pole forms the moving ridge below the high cut.

primitives.name: low_zero_sub_cut
primitives.mountain_canyon_use: Use when the body needs a low antiresonant floor or high-pass-like bite without inventing an extra hidden stage.

generation_rule: A pristine preset seed must be expressible as six registered lanes assembled from these primitive roles, a clean-room physical/table rail, or a section-law-v1 law. Random pole/zero clouds are rejected.
